name: Valley of the Watchers
summary: At Tanaris’s southern edge, the sealed gate at the Valley of the Watchers keeps Uldum beyond reach. Stone sentinels and lumbering giants guard the ancient complex.

sections.title: The Sealed Threshold
sections.body: At the valley’s southern end, a massive stone gate bars the way. It is believed to guard Uldum, a subterranean facility of the enigmatic Titans. Dune Smasher mountain giants roam the dusty approach, keeping travelers, tomb robbers, and scholars from disturbing what lies beneath the sands. The valley marks Tanaris’s southern boundary, where shifting desert sands meet the continent’s mountainous edge.

faq.q: What is behind the huge stone gate here?
faq.answer: The monumental doors lead into Uldum, an ancient subterranean facility built by the Titans before mortal history was recorded. The mechanisms remain sealed, and the complex’s contents and purpose are a mystery.

faq.q: Can the gate to Uldum be opened?
aliases: can you open the uldum gate
faq.answer: No. The massive stone gates remain impassable. No mortal key, spell, or force known in Kalimdor can bypass the Titan safeguards that lock the complex shut.

faq.q: Why are there giants wandering the valley?
faq.answer: Dune Smashers, colossal mountain giants, prowl the canyon floor. Drawn by the area’s potent earthen energy, they fiercely guard the approach and crush adventurers who stray too close to the southern cliffs.

faq.q: Where in Tanaris is this valley located?
aliases: how to find valley of the watchers
faq.answer: The valley lies at Tanaris’s far southern edge, south of Thistleshrub Valley and the gaping chasms of Southbreak Shores. It is carved into the towering southern mountain wall.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may see the massive stone gateway as another tantalizing clue in the search for your Titan creators.
